prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Cloud Backup Active", "Verifying existing desktop companion save states..."]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready", "Let's try a quick 30-second practice run of your pet commands.", "Try Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice hiding, recalling, and speaking with your companion on desktop.", "Test Hide Command", "Press Option+Space to speak anytime"]
2: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is customized and ready to move onto your desktop environment.", "Traits Render Verified"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Habitat", "Feed & Play While You Wait", "Tap items to interact with your pet while high-resolution rendering finishes.", "Give Treat"]
4: ["Desktop Companion Rendering in Progress", "Building 3D Desktop Sprites..."]
5: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Here is your quick guide to controlling your companion anytime from your desktop.", "Click Pet: Open Menu | Double Click: Play | Cmd+Shift+P: Hide/Show", "Got It, Launch Pet"]
6: ["Choose Your Companion Journey"]
7: ["Choose Your Pet's Voice & Personality Sound", "Listen to sound samples and pick the tone that best fits your companion.", "Cheerful Meow / Bark", "Select Accent & Pitch"]
8: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe & Sync Across Devices", "Signing in connects your pet to cloud backup so your customizations are never lost."]
9: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Your companion is now active in your menu bar and ready to interact.", "Active on Desktop"]
